chronology: June inner; July-September selector; September fresh refit; October-December calibration; exact original outer keys
maturity: strict ET cutoff midnight +1 day -4 hours; first of48 input steps strictly after prior cutoff

model.selector: loss<=.999*best; min12 patience10 max60; fresh seed42 refit

weights: equal stock within origin; equal origin within session; equal session within year; equal years

baselines.CLOCK: weighted stock-slot raw mean, shrink50 origin-equivalent observations toward stock mean; role weights rescaled to mean1 per origin

VOL.objective: Ew raw squared error + lambda sum(nonintercept coefficients^2)
VOL.selection: June fit, July-September raw MSE; ties first listed; September fresh refit; max0 prediction

diagnostics.deciles: 10 weighted empirical C0 score bins per OOS year, descriptive; same bins for all arms
diagnostics.tails: restricted-September prefix weighted95/99 of raw A; strict exceedance
diagnostics.uncertainty: existing400 whole-month bootstrap seed22042; post-search descriptive

protection: No2025/2026 numeric observations/hashes; no minute reads or source downloads; no retries/other objectives
